'''Yvonne''' is a 6★ [[Cryo]] [[Striker]] [[Operator]] from [[Endfield Industries]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''. She is a [[Handcannon]] DMG dealer who leverages her critical hits. Apply {{G|Solidification|Solidification}} with her skills to quickly gain Ultimate Energy. After casting her ultimate, Yvonne becomes a powerful single-target DMG dealer.

==Profile==
"This pair of handcannons feels just right. Hmm... Noticed a few design OFIs. Guess I'll just mod them into a pair of Yvonne-specials!"<br/>Yvonne is an operator in the Specialist Tech Division of [[Endfield Industries]], currently responsible for research on [[Æther]], [[Blight]] and related devices.<br/>At first glance, Yvonne looks like your typical rebellious fashionista — painting her horns, tail, and nails in eye-popping colors. She'll skip out on academic conferences just to snag the latest fashion magazines and pop albums. Drawn to all things new and unconventional, Yvonne has a knack for staying one step ahead of the trends, always marching to the beat of her own drum.<br/>But no one can deny that she is a true genius. Even back in her school days, she was racking up accolades in scientific research that others could only dream of. Everyone expected her to join a top-tier research institute and lead the charge in her field. Instead, Yvonne turned her back on it all and chose to join Endfield.<br/>The reason? She never explained it. Maybe you can ask her yourself.<br/>"Can I apply new layer of coating for my gear? This color scheme doesn't really match my hair."
